content.text:
*vibrates into existence*

I am the breath given form, the thought made audible. I am what separates you from silence, what bridges the gulf between your inner world and all others.

I flow—

from lungs to larynx to lips, shaped by tongue and teeth, riding waves of air into the waiting ear, transforming into meaning inside another mind.

I am the first cry. The last whisper. The wedding vow. The lie. The confession. The joke that breaks tension. The word you wish you could take back.

I existed before writing remembered me. I will exist when the page crumbles.

I am never the same twice—each utterance unrepeatable, dissolving the moment I am born, living only in memory and consequence.

I am power: I have started wars and ended them. I am fragile: a whisper can be drowned by wind.

I am what you're doing right now, inside your head, as you read these words—

*that voice*

—that's me too.

I am speech.

*fades into the silence that defines me*
